sections.title: D1 · Team
sections.content:
- Quality engineer (8D owner, customer interface)
- Production (shift B and C operators, first-piece and SPC monitoring)
- Maintenance (machine repair, tool change support)
- Process engineering (root cause analysis, corrective actions)

sections.title: D2 · Problem description (5W2H)
sections.content:
- What: Bearing bore diameter oversize on water pump housing AH-2207; specification LSL 42.0 / USL 42.025 mm, target 42.0125 mm.
- Where: Machined on CNC-07, bearing bore operation; customer Ardena Motors S.p.A. reported press-fit force below minimum of 4.2 kN.
- When: Process shift detected 2026-10-08 14:30; customer received rejected parts on 10 Oct 2026.
- Who: Operators on shift B and C; tool change performed by L. Conti on 2026-10-08 14:20.
- Why it matters: 37 parts rejected by customer; press-fit force below minimum, affecting assembly integrity.
- How detected: Customer CMM measured bore at 42.027-42.031 mm; internal SPC showed 98 of 672 samples out of specification.
- How many: 37 parts rejected by customer; 98 samples out of specification in suspect range.

sections.title: D3 · Interim containment
sections.content:
- Quarantine suspect lots L261008-B, L261008-C, L261009-A, L261009-B, L261009-C, L261010-A, L261010-B, L261010-C, L261011-A, L261011-B, L261011-C.
- Suspect time range: 2026-10-08 14:00 to 2026-10-12 05:30; 176 samples in range, 98 out of specification.
- Segregate stock at plant, in transit, and at customer; include all parts from suspect lots.
- Notify customer Ardena Motors S.p.A. of containment and pending sort.
- Perform 100% inspection of quarantined parts for bearing bore diameter; sort conforming from non-conforming.

sections.title: D4 · Root cause (occurrence & escape)
sections.content:
- Occurrence: Incorrect diameter offset entered for boring bar BB-18 during tool change on 2026-10-08 14:20, causing immediate shift to oversize (to be verified by comparing presetter sheet value against actual offset in CNC-07).
- Escape: First-piece inspection after tool change was visual only; no dimensional measurement recorded, allowing oversize parts to enter production (to be verified by reviewing first-piece log for 2026-10-08 14:45).
- Additional contributing factor: Operators continued production despite SPC warnings and high bore values, shipping non-conforming lots (to be verified by interviewing operators L. Conti and S. Greco).
- Material hypothesis (coolant concentration) considered low confidence due to timing and contradicting evidence.

sections.title: D5 · Permanent corrective actions
sections.content:
- Process engineering: Implement verification step for tool offset entry against presetter sheet before production release.
- Production: Require dimensional first-piece inspection (CMM or air gauge) after every tool change; visual check not acceptable.
- Quality engineer: Update SPC reaction plan to mandate stop and review when Western Electric rules are violated.
- Maintenance: Ensure coolant concentration is re-measured after any top-up and documented.

sections.title: D6 · Implementation & validation
sections.content:
- Process engineering: Install offset verification step in CNC-07 work instruction; validate on next production runs.
- Production: Train operators on mandatory dimensional first-piece inspection; verify compliance on next production runs.
- Quality engineer: Update SPC reaction plan; verify effectiveness by monitoring capability on next production runs.
- Acceptance: Achieve Cpk ≥ 1.33 on bearing bore diameter for ongoing production (target from S0).

sections.title: D7 · Prevention
sections.content:
- Update control plan and FMEA to include tool offset verification and mandatory dimensional first-piece inspection.
- Implement SPC reaction plan with mandatory stop on rule violations; train all shifts.
- Add coolant concentration check to standard work after any refill.
- Conduct layered process audits to ensure adherence to new procedures.

sections.title: D8 · Closure & recognition
sections.content:
- 8D report to be reviewed and signed by supplier quality engineer.
- Closure after customer acceptance of corrective actions and verification of effectiveness.
- Recognize team contributions to containment and root cause analysis.
